'''Joe Lake''' of Taylor, Michigan finished 29th of 49 at the [[1999 Corellia Regionals]] in Indianapolis with 6 (−45).<ref name="cec-reg">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html 1999 Corellia Regional Championship], Alex Alcalde, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000618013958/http://www.geocities.com:80/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html Internet Archive]</ref> He lost to [[Frank Lamantia]] in the fourth game.
